text:
maya: Quick mock — compact channel list for SLO alerts. Two things: 1) show priority chips inline (High/Low), 2) when suppression is on show a single 'Muted until' pill with hover details. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/figma/abcd

sam: Nice. Need to confirm product constraints: customers want to toggle channel order; also wording: should we say 'Muted' or 'Suppressed'? @linh any a11y concerns?

ria: From backend: current notification config is array of {channel, priority, enabled}. Adding 'order' is trivial; suppression -> we already have `paused_until` field so UI maps easily. Example:
```
[{"channel":"pagerduty","priority":"high","enabled":true},
{"channel":"email","priority":"low","enabled":true}]
```

linh: a11y: focus + live region matter. When user enables suppression we should announce: "Notifications muted for SLO 'Payment Latency' until 03/12 14:00". Use aria-live="polite" and update a hidden status element. Also keyboard: ensure the mute pill is focusable and pressing Enter opens details. Avoid using only color to indicate priority.

tobias: Design note — compact variant: show chip + 1-line copy and a chevron for details. For screen readers, add visually-hidden full list. Mock small: [PagerDuty · High] [Email · Low] [Muted until 3/12]. I prefer the label 'Muted' over 'Suppressed' by default.

maya: Good call on 'Muted'. I'll update copy. Two quick asks: 1) show preview of which channels will actually receive a notification (respecting routing rules) in the hovercard? 2) handle long lists — collapse into "+3 more" link that expands inline.

ria: hover preview is doable but could be expensive if we compute routing live. Suggest we cache last computed routing per-rule and refresh on save. For expand/collapse, use lazy load.

linh: For the preview hovercard, ensure it's keyboard accessible (focusable) and that expanded content gets focus. Also in collapsed state provide aria-expanded on the toggle.

sam: Decision: use "Muted" label, include compact chips, add a keyboard-focusable mute pill, and implement cached hover preview MVP. @maya please send final copy for review tomorrow.

maya: Will do. Thanks! :thumbsup:
